user.title: Add tracking source
user.description:
A tracking source fetches the shipment status directly from the carrier, even when no further mail arrives.

- **17TRACK account (personal, free):** signs in with the email and password of your regular 17TRACK account, like the Home Assistant 17TRACK integration.
- **17TRACK API (paid):** official interface with an API key from a separate developer account.

mailbox_auth_failed.title: Login to mailbox {source} rejected
mailbox_auth_failed.description:
The mail server rejects the username or password for {source}. The mailbox is no longer checked until the credentials are correct.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Delivery Tracker**, open the menu of the mailbox {source}, choose **Reconfigure** and enter the current password. Providers that require two-factor sign-in need an app password.

This notice disappears as soon as the mailbox has been checked successfully again.

mailbox_folder_not_found.title: Folder in mailbox {source} is missing
mailbox_folder_not_found.description:
The configured folder of {source} no longer exists or cannot be opened, for example because it was renamed. The mailbox is no longer checked.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Delivery Tracker**, open the menu of the mailbox {source}, choose **Reconfigure** and select the folder again.

This notice disappears as soon as the mailbox has been checked successfully again.

api_key_invalid.title: API key for {source} is invalid
api_key_invalid.description:
{source} rejects the API key; it has probably expired or been revoked. The source is no longer queried.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Delivery Tracker**, open the menu of the API source {source}, choose **Reconfigure** and enter a valid key.

This notice disappears as soon as the source has been queried successfully again.

api_login_invalid.title: Sign-in to {source} failed
api_login_invalid.description:
{source} rejects the email address or password; the password has probably been changed. The source is no longer queried.

Go to **Settings → Devices & services → Delivery Tracker**, open the menu of the tracking source {source}, choose **Reconfigure** and enter the current credentials.

This notice disappears as soon as the source has been queried successfully again.

api_quota_exhausted.title: Quota of {source} used up
api_quota_exhausted.description:
The quota of the API key for {source} is used up. New tracking numbers are not registered for now; shipments that are already registered are still queried, and emails are still processed.

Either wait until {source} renews the quota, or go to **Settings → Devices & services → Delivery Tracker**, open the menu of the API source {source}, choose **Reconfigure** and enter a different key.

This notice disappears as soon as quota is available again or no number is waiting to be registered.
